tooltips.cBillDuration: Seconds of conversation: from the human answer to the first hang-up (PBXManager history: Vtiger billduration).
tooltips.cAsteriskLinkedId: Asterisk linkedid, the key of a live telephony call (stage 07.1); the CDR history of stage 07.2 uses it too.
tooltips.cLiveState: Set by the Asterisk integration. «Ended (not observed)»: the call ended while the AMI listener was down; the end time is the last one known.
tooltips.cExtension: The extension that called (outbound) or answered or rang first (inbound).
tooltips.cRecording: Playback is for those who may read the call unless their roles forbid this field. Every playback is logged in Action History.

labels.Recording is being written: The recording appears when the call ends

messages.telephonyFactsReadOnly: The direction, times, status, number and recording of a telephony call are changed only by the Asterisk integration.
messages.telephonyCallInitiated: Your phone {extension} will ring now: pick it up and the number is dialled automatically.
messages.telephonyNoExtension: Your account has no extension (or another user has the same one): calls from the CRM are not available. Ask the administrator.
messages.telephonyNumberRefused: This number cannot be dialled from the CRM (several numbers in one value, an extension or a non-standard format).
messages.telephonyRateLimited: A call from the CRM has just been requested, wait a few seconds.
messages.telephonyPbxUnavailable: The PBX is not available now, the call was not started.
